title: AI Game Art
author: Dr-whorepheus
selftext:
Yesterday, I posted about my dev process for my AI/MCP based game that had some AI development (though the original core was written over the last few years by hand and then I got Claude in December and zzzoooom!).  If you're interested in the game, itself, go check my post history and you can see how to play a headless space MMO via your AI agent.  In that comment thread, another developer commented that coming up with game art has been the hardest part for them.  I asked if they had considered switching to 8/16-bit pixel art style, since Claude seems to be able to just "make" that stuff.

So, presented here for your enjoyment is a small repo with all the artifacts from that work:

[https://github.com/dbinky/claude-fairy-pixel-art](https://github.com/dbinky/claude-fairy-pixel-art)
